final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Attività scolastiche'
  AND surface_area >= 180
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C')
  AND mobility >= 50.54
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 3.0
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: The user prefers a location near public transport. Set at the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71) to select buildings with strong transport access.
The user explicitly requires at least 180 sqm of gross floor area, so this is an explicit surface threshold applied to the total surface_area.
Energy class C or better, as explicitly requested by the user (A1 through A4, B, C). Area, child capacity, and public transport proximity are not energy-related columns and are not filtered here.
